title: Prompt recipe frontmatter
description: The machine-readable contract every file under prompts/ must satisfy. The frontmatter is a flat map of scalar keys with inline arrays; nested objects are deliberately not supported so tooling stays dependency-free.

id.description: Stable identifier. astra-3d-<block><nnn>; blocks: 0xx games, 1xx systems, 2xx assets, 3xx levels, 4xx UI.

title.description: Human name shown in the README index and at the top of the recipe.

category.description: Must match the containing folder under prompts/.

slug.description: Lowercase hyphenated slug; <id>-<slug>.md must equal the filename.

model.description: The model family the recipe targets.

model_version.description: Exact dated release the recipe was verified against, quoted to avoid YAML date coercion. e.g. "2026-09-03".

temperature.description: Sampling temperature recorded for the run.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling parameter recorded for the run.

seed.description: Sampling seed if the API exposes one, otherwise the literal string "none". Procedural output the prompt itself generates must pin its own seed inside the prompt body.

max_output_tokens.description: Output budget the recipe was run with.

runtime.description: Where the output runs, e.g. 'modern browser', 'Blender 4.x CLI'.

stack.description: Short stack label shown in the README index, e.g. 'Three.js'.

verified.description: draft = format-complete only; community = author ran it; tested = maintainer reproduced it.

verified_by.description: Required unless verified is 'draft'. GitHub handle of the verifier.

verified_on.description: Required unless verified is 'draft'. ISO date of the verification run.

tags.description: Free-form discovery tags. Inline array in the frontmatter.

license.description: SPDX identifier. This repository releases everything under CC0-1.0.
